name: Maki-San - Century Square
description:
WE'RE A ROLLVOLUTION BECAUSE WE'RE ASIA'S FIRST D.I.Y SUSHI & SALAD RESTAURANT

Founded in 2012, Maki-San brought the concept of fun and endless possibilities to the masses. It is the original brand in Asia, which allows customers to create their own sushi and salads.

If you are constantly searching for different flavours and exotic ingredients from all over the world to add into your sushi or salad, Maki-San is perfect for you because we have over 70 ingredients to choose from so every roll is a new possibility.

At Maki-San, our customers select their favourite type of wrap, choose their preferred fillings, and then add delicious toppings and sauces to create their own masterpieces.

Basically, in just 5 simple steps, you can start creating their own sushi or salad. You can also choose from a variety of ready-to-go sushi and salad options.

So try Maki-San today and have some fun, because now you can create your own sushi or salad and make it the way you like it.
